is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper discusses kdr resistance in the context of literature review (page 2, Background) but does not report any genotyping of resistance markers for the mosquitoes collected in this study.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The study only reports phenotypic bioassay data (knockdown time and mortality rates) in Table 1 (page 3). No genotype data is provided.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from field sites in Kamwenge District, Uganda (page 2, Materials and methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original bioassay results.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies collection from five parishes in Kamwenge District, Uganda (page 2, Materials and methods).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study reports data collected over a 10-year period from 1998 to 2007 (Table 1, page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This appears to be an independent study of local mosquito populations.

supplement.evidence: No genotype data was collected, so no supplementary data is needed for this purpose.

assessment.summary: This study reports phenotypic resistance (knockdown time and mortality) of Anopheles gambiae s.l. to pyrethroids in western Uganda from 1998-2007. It does not perform or report any molecular genotyping of insecticide resistance markers.
exclusion_reasons: temporal_resolution_within_3y: The study covers a 10-year period.
